units.source_text: “大胆采用古典的格调算了。”太吉郎有时这么嘀咕。

en.t: I will boldly adopt a classical tone, Taikichiro sometimes muttered to himself.

units.source_text: 当年的各种优秀作品，又不断地浮现在他的眼前。

en.t: All sorts of outstanding works from those days kept appearing before his eyes again.

units.source_text: 古代的织锦和古代的衣裳花色，也都进入了他的脑海。

en.t: Ancient brocades and the colors and patterns of ancient garments also came into his mind.

units.source_text: 当然，他经常到京都的名园或山野漫步，作些和服花样的写生。

en.t: Of course, he often walked through Kyoto's famous gardens or the hills and fields, making sketches for kimono patterns.
